long_biography.plain_text:
Property investor Max-Hervé George bought his first plot near Paris at eighteen, using a bank guarantee. He sold it at a profit and left law studies to concentrate on business. In his partnership with Byron Baciocchi, George handled investment and financing while Baciocchi took responsibility for construction and development.

Beyond business, he entered a four-year cooperation agreement with the International Judo Federation in 2021. Its stated objectives included extending judo to disadvantaged communities, assisting refugees and widening the World Judo Tour's audience. George cited the influence of French champions he had watched growing up when explaining his commitment to the sport.
